notes.title: Save 75% on Lovingly Evil - One Week Only!
notes.content:
If you've ever wanted to play a romantic visual novel with a wicked twist, now's your chance to grab Lovingly Evil for less.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019223/0d4000989664422aa5923c1f76de0c4f54d880ce.png[/img]
Save [b]75% off this week only [/b]and head to the Villain Conference where you can have demonic dalliances and more in this one-of-a-kind game.

notes.title: 75% OFF SALE
notes.content:
Lovingly Evil is currently available on sale with [b]75% OFF[/b] right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1247020/

Welcome to the Villain Conference, your number one opportunity to make connections with other villains, whether you're a necromancer, a criminal mastermind or an evil demi-god!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019223/9efb8e6a32a2c80886e3efcb1ca8ae2841f40a91.png[/img]

Network with baddies from countless dimensions and universes, create your own villainous character from hundreds of options and experience a lovingly evil story like no other!

Take advantage of this 75% discount before it disappears. We are sure you'll have a wicked time!

notes.title: Launch date confirmed for 19 Aug, 2020
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Lovingly Evil will go live 19 Aug 2020! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019223/d1b8f7fde24bb5ff46d43cda2c825c3c7befab24.gif[/img]

We hope to see you all at the Villan Conference then! 

Oh and don't forget to add Lovingly Evil to your Steam Wishlist!

notes.title: Join us at 5pm BST - 12 noon ET for a Developer live stream!
notes.content:
We hope you can join us for the Developer Livestream session for Lovingly Evil where you will see some gameplay, and learn more about the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019223/30d4d4cc60240947d302ab316a04783df68ee1c6.png[/img]


Lovingly Evil will be coming to PC later this Summer! We hope you like what you have seen so far and don't forget to wishlist the game!

notes.title: The Lovingly Evil demo is now live as part of the Steam Game Festival!
notes.content:
We welcome you all to try out the Lovingly Evil demo first hand right here right now! 

So dust off your cape and head to the villain conference for some exciting lectures, networking and maybe even to find love, as even villains need love! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019223/30d4d4cc60240947d302ab316a04783df68ee1c6.png[/img]

If you enjoy the demo we welcome you all to join the live stream on Steam later this week (date to be confirmed)!

But most importantly of all have fun and we really appreciate it if you add Lovingly Evil to your Wishlist to stay informed of the exciting news to come!

notes.title: Lovingly Evil Demo Coming June 16th!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce Lovingly Evil coming this summer! Not only will you be able to play the full game on its release later this summer you will also be able to play the demo for free from June 16th as part of the Steam Game Festival!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019223/2778384d63800f9f9f84bcc7dcfa982dba389894.png[/img]

If you would like to know more about the game check out what GameReactor had to say here:

https://www.gamereactor.eu/dating-for-villains-is-here-at-last-in-lovingly-evil/


Don't forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist to keep up to date with all the latest news and announcements!
